resource.name: Capital Planning Proposal Lines (Gold Copy)
resource.description:
A consolidated dataset shared with Hub.  It contains all CIP Proposal lines with related Project details. This Dataset includes excluded lines.  For a view of the current state of the Plan, filtered to Most Current and Included.

Note: This dataset contains all proposals, Included and Excluded.    The reason is that is expected that customers will do advanced evaluation of the data in determining the best mix of included projects.   For Visualizations / Reports that represent the current state of the CIP Plan, set a Filter to Included = True.
